credentials.name: Bitbucket
credentials.description: Read access to Bitbucket Cloud repositories and pull requests.
credentials.help: Use your own Bitbucket API token to act as yourself; otherwise your team's or the tenant's read-only account is used. Create one under Bitbucket → Personal settings → API tokens (read scopes are enough).

credentials.name: Jira
credentials.description: Your Atlassian account for Jira tools. Each person uses their own, so issues are read and written as you.
credentials.help: Username is your Atlassian e-mail. Create an API token at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens.

credentials.name: Gerrit
credentials.description: HTTP password of a Gerrit account: lists and reviews changes, pushes changes for review.
credentials.help: Username is your Gerrit username; the secret is the HTTP password from Gerrit → Settings → HTTP Credentials. The local CI stack (compose.ci.yml) provides the platform account for the tenant.

credentials.name: Jenkins
credentials.description: A Jenkins user and API token for reading builds and logs.
credentials.help: Username is your Jenkins user; create the token under your user → Security → API Token. The local CI stack (compose.ci.yml) provides the platform's token for the tenant.

credentials.name: Nexus
credentials.description: Read access to the internal Nexus package repository through a shared account. Only tenant and team admins set it.
credentials.help: Create a token for the shared build account in Nexus → Security → User Token.

credentials.name: PagerDuty
credentials.description: Your PagerDuty API key, so on-call tools act as you. acme requires it of everyone in the ops team.
credentials.help: Create a user API key in PagerDuty → My Profile → User Settings → API Access.

mcp_servers.name: Bitbucket (read-only)
mcp_servers.description: Pull requests, diffs and repository details from Bitbucket Cloud.

mcp_servers.name: Jenkins (read-only)
mcp_servers.description: Jobs, builds, pipeline stages and logs from Jenkins.

mcp_servers.name: Jira
mcp_servers.description: Issues and comments in Jira, as yourself.

teams.name: Demo team
teams.description: Sample team with one workflow for every activity.

teams.name: Payments
teams.description: Small team with a workspace and a limit of two running sessions, for testing team roles and limits.

teams.name: Operations
teams.description: Team with a scheduled workspace and a tiny daily token budget, for testing platform-started sessions and budgets.
